newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR largely lower, long-term unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR largely lower, long-term unchanged.

text.p: Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) were mostly lower on Thursday, except for the long end of the curve which was unchanged, traders said.
"As expected, the PHIBOR just went along with the spot rates which went down after the Central Bank rate cuts," one trader said.

The Central Bank cut its benchmark overnight and term reverse repo rates after the peso gained strength in recent weeks. The Central Bank was forced to raise its rates last month to ward off peso speculation at the height of the Thai baht problem.
